title: Filling a ten frame to see numbers
examples: How do I show thirteen on a ten frame?

explain.say: Look at the board. This is a ten frame. It has 2 rows of 5 spaces. There are 6 counters in it. How many spaces are empty?

draw.text: Filling a ten frame to see numbers

explain.say: Here are 8 counters. There are 2 empty spaces. So 8 needs 2 more to make 10. The empty spaces show how many more make 10.
Now the frame is full. There are 10 counters. Every space has a counter. Can you clap 10 times?
This is 13. One full frame is 10. 3 more go in a new frame. 10 and 3 make 13. Can you see the 10 and the 3?
This is 16. It is 1 full ten and 6 more. Every teen number is 10 and some more. Today, draw a ten frame on paper. Use buttons to make your age.

faq.a: A ten frame is a box with two rows of five spaces, ten spaces in all. You put counters in it to see numbers.
asks: Tell me about the ten frame

faq.q: Why are the empty spaces useful?
faq.a: The empty spaces show how many more you need to make ten. Eight counters leave two spaces, so eight and two make ten.

faq.q: How do I show numbers bigger than ten?
faq.a: Fill one frame to make ten, then put the rest in a second frame. Thirteen is one full frame and three more.
Teen numbers, like thirteen and sixteen, are ten and some more. Sixteen is ten and six.

faq.q: Can I make my own ten frame?
faq.a: Yes. Draw two rows of five squares on paper. Use buttons or beans as counters. A grown-up can help you make it.
asks: How do I make a ten frame?

facts: A ten frame has two rows of five spaces.
Every teen number, from eleven to nineteen, is ten and some more ones.

quiz.say: Look at the ten frame. It has 7 counters. How many spaces are empty?
quiz.show: 7 counters in a ten frame. How many empty spaces?
quiz.why: 7 and 3 make 10. So 3 spaces are empty.

wrong.1: 7 and 4 make 11, which is 1 more than the frame holds.
wrong.2: 7 is the number of counters in the frame.

quiz.say: A ten frame is full. 5 more go in a new frame. How many counters are there?
quiz.show: 1 full ten frame and 5 more. How many?
quiz.why: A full frame is 10. 10 and 5 make 15.

wrong.0: 5 is the counters in the new frame only.
